4480.title: Docs host sources omit environment host routing
4480.rootCauseOneLine: Host-source resolver drops environmentId and passes no host to file SDK operations.
4480.proposedFix: Resolve the environment host when no explicit host ID is supplied.
4480.caveats: Same-agent two clean runs verify plugin RPCs with synthetic file adapters; real HTTP/daemon/browser and 502 remain untested.
